## 3. Sprint 13 Delivered Breakdown (Commit `6352cdf`)

- **Greeks Hedging Engine (`src/lib/greeksHedgerEngine.ts`, `src/types/greeksHedger.ts`):** 
  - Real-time continuous linear superposition of portfolio Greeks: Delta ($\Delta$), Gamma ($\Gamma$), Vega ($\mathcal{V}$), Theta ($\Theta$), and Rho ($\rho$).
  - Closed-form Delta-Neutral Solver calculating exact underlying shares or ATM option contracts to drive $\Delta_{\text{net}} \to 0$.
  - Simultaneous 2-instrument Delta-Gamma Neutral Solver solving matrix system:
    $$\begin{pmatrix} \Delta_1 & \Delta_2 \\ \Gamma_1 & \Gamma_2 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} n_1 \\ n_2 \end{pmatrix} = -\begin{pmatrix} \Delta_{\text{port}} \\ \Gamma_{\text{port}} \end{pmatrix}$$
  - Taylor Series second-order price shock approximation ($\Delta P \approx \Delta \cdot \Delta S + \frac{1}{2} \Gamma (\Delta S)^2$).
  - Configurable deadband tolerance filters ($|\Delta| > \delta_{\text{tol}}$) and Indian statutory tax cost friction estimation (`taxEngine.ts`).
- **Interactive UI Modals:**
  - `GreeksHedgerModal.tsx`: 4 real-time risk gauges with color-coded safety/danger zones, 2D curvature P&L visualizer across $\pm 5\%$ spot swings, Autobalancer daemon toggle with frequency slider, and 1-click "Execute Neutralizing Hedge" button.
- **State & Terminal Synchronization:** "🛡️ Delta Hedger" navigation button with live net Delta status pill in `Header.tsx`, Landing Page feature card, and direct integration into `TradingContext.tsx`.
- **Test Coverage:** Added 7 new automated tests (`greeksHedgerEngine.test.mjs`), expanding test suite to 55 total passing assertions.

## 4. Sprint 14 Kickoff: Multi-Leg Options Strategy Payoff Optimizer & Implied Volatility Surface Calibrator

### 4.1 Vision & Scope
Sprint 14 introduces institutional volatility surface calibration and combinatorial strategy payoff optimization:
1. **Parametric Volatility Models:** Non-linear least squares calibration of Hagan's SABR ($\alpha, \beta, \rho, \nu$) and Gatheral's SVI models across NSE strike grids.
2. **Arbitrage-Free Verification:** Automated detection and filtering of butterfly arbitrage ($g(k) < 0$) and calendar spread arbitrage across consecutive option expiries.
3. **Dupire Local Volatility:** Extraction of local volatility surface $\sigma_{\text{loc}}(S, t)$ from calibrated implied variance.
4. **Combinatorial Strategy Payoff Optimizer:** Scans combinations of multi-leg options (Iron Condors, Butterflies, Calendar Spreads, Jade Lizards, Ratio Spreads) to maximize probability of profit (POP) and risk-reward ratio given a user's market outlook, strictly factoring in Indian statutory taxes.
